good_thing: (Seal Beach and Huntington Beach, California): Olive ridley hatchlings from two nests have been released from the beaches where they were laid, after hatching under the Aquarium of the Pacific’s care. The November 14 and 15 releases followed the first confirmed natural sea-turtle nesting event of any species on the U.S. West Coast.
current_or_history: On November 20, 1923, Cleveland inventor Garrett Morgan received a patent for an improved traffic signal. Inspired after seeing an automobile collide with a horse-drawn cart, he designed a hand-cranked signal with an all-direction stop interval so people and vehicles already in an intersection could clear it.
tiny_fact: Some deep craters near the Moon’s poles have not received direct sunlight for billions of years. There, sunlight arrives at such a low angle that crater rims can block it completely, leaving their floors permanently shadowed.
